symptom: Commands launched through the canonical wrapper lost the project declaration after resolution and doctor could not validate project-bound state.
whyGateMissed: Direct CLI tests supplied --project explicitly, so they did not exercise the wrapper-to-core environment contract used by later selected CLI invocations.
earliestDetection: Run doctor without --project under the exact RELKIT_PROJECT context exported by generated wrappers and require it to load the project successfully.
